subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Johnson <ella@fintechco.com>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mark@fintechco.com>, Priya Singh <priya@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Ella / team,

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo today — appreciate how focused the group was. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

What we covered
- Live walkthrough of Redwood inference runtime, routing/fallbacks, and cost controls
- Example perf numbers on your target workload (10k qps, median latency target ~<200ms)
- Data controls: VPC/private deployment options + KMS integrations

Key decision criteria you flagged
1) Latency (p50/p90) and predictable throughput under burst
2) Unit cost / TCO relative to existing infra
3) Security & compliance (SOC 2 + data retention / residency)
4) Ease of integration and rollout plan

Stakeholder map from today's call
- Economic buyer: Mark Rivera (CTO)
- Technical champion: Priya Singh (Lead Data Eng)
- Procurement / legal: procurement@fintechco.com (please confirm)

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll send SOC2 summary and a short mutual action plan (MAP) for review — attaching pricing deck now.
2) Procurement + legal loop: recommend a brief sync to go over contracting and redlines (target: Thu Aug 27)
3) Technical deep-dive with your engineering (Priya) to validate latency/TCO assumptions

Can you confirm: 1) Mark is the economic approver, and 2) procurement@fintechco.com is the right narrow procurement contact? Also if there are any additional decision criteria we missed.

Suggested times for procurement sync: Thu Aug 27 10:00am PT or 2:00pm PT — happy to accommodate.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-deck.pdf

Thanks,
--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700

Thanks Marissa — great demo. A few quick notes and asks from our side: 

- Confirmed: Mark Rivera is the economic buyer and will be the final approver on spend.
- Procurement contact is procurement@fintechco.com (I’ve cc'd them).
- Immediate asks from procurement/legal/security: SOC 2 report or summary, data retention policy, and standard IP/data residency language. We also need a sample contract or redlines to start our legal review.

Can you send the SOC2 attestation (or a summary) and a draft MAP so we can align internal milestones? If you can get procurement/contracting materials to them before Thu that would be ideal.

Also looping in Mark for visibility.

On the technical side, Priya will want a targeted follow-up to verify performance numbers at our average sequence lengths — she’ll share a data sample and preferred test window.

Thanks,
—

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Johnson <ella@fintechco.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Cc: Mark Rivera <mark@fintechco.com>, Priya Singh <priya@fintechco.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Ella — great, appreciate the clarity. Per your asks, please find attached a short SOC 2 summary and a first draft MAP. I’ve also attached the pricing deck you saw during the demo.

Quick stakeholder & process summary (to make procurement/ legal routing easier):
- Economic buyer: Mark Rivera (CTO) — primary approver for budget and contract.
- Procurement / Legal: procurement@fintechco.com — primary contracting contact.
- Technical champion: Priya Singh — will validate perf + integration scope.

Decision criteria we heard (priority):
1) Latency: p50/p90 targets (we agreed to target p90 < 200ms for the sample workload)
2) TCO: target unit costs vs current infra (we’ll run numbers after you share sample trace)
3) Security/compliance: SOC2 attestation, data residency, access controls

Next steps / timeline
1) Procurement sync: Thu Aug 27 — confirm best time (I’m proposing 10:00am PT).
2) Security package: We can provide full SOC2 attestation under NDA and a short one-page summary now (attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
3) MAP: attached draft-mpa.xlsx — includes milestones (PO, contract signature, sandbox onboarding, pilot go-live). Please review and comment with any internal milestone dates.
4) Technical validation: Priya to provide sample sequence lengths and a preferred window; Dev will run a scoped perf run and share results.

Can procurement/legal advise which contract template you prefer (our SaaS MSA, or your standard PO/terms)? If you prefer a quick route to redlines, we can start with the DocuSign sample contract link I’ve included.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, draft-mpa.xlsx, redwood-pricing-deck.pdf

Thanks — looping in Dev and Lauren to coordinate the technical materials and onboarding timeline.

Best,
--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Dev / Lauren — forwarding the thread with FintechCo. Action items we need to turn around today/tomorrow so procurement can start review: 

1) Dev: prepare a short SOC2 attestation snippet (1 page) summarizing scope and where attestation lives (link to attestation PDF). Also prepare a scoped perf run plan: what we need from Priya (sample traces), expected runtime, and a p90 latency estimate for the pilot (add any assumptions).

2) Lauren: draft a proposed onboarding timeline (MAP -> sandbox -> pilot -> production) with estimated resource hours and an initial success metric set (uptime, latency, cost per inference). Aim to have a 2-week pilot plan and an outline of onboarding tasks.

3) Both: please update the MAP (draft-mpa.xlsx) where applicable and add short notes for procurement/legal on contract term preferences and any SOW items we expect. Procurement asked for a sample contract to begin redlines — I included a DocuSign link in the thread.

Target: have SOC2 snippet + updated MAP + onboarding timeline by end of day Thu Aug 27 so I can share with procurement before their internal review.
